headline: Frostburg State concede seven goals all season
dek: Frostburg State have won 16 matches and drawn three, scoring more goals than any other programme in the conference while conceding seven. They have been beaten twice all season, and not since Point Park beat them in September.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Goals scored do not order this conference: Point Park have won 13 matches on 18 goals, conceding nine.

wire.line: Point Park's Nicole Kuchinski has kept 13 shutouts and let in seven goals all season.
